param.label: Phyloseq object (.Rdata)
param.help: Rdata file generated by the FROGS Stat 'Phyloseq Import data' tool.

param.label: Experimental variable
param.help: Sample metadata variable expected to influence ASV abundances (e.g., Treatment, Environment, Site, etc.).

param.name: correction
param.label: Correct for a confounding factor?
param.help: If yes, specify an additional sample metadata variable that could affect ASV abundances.

param.name: conf_factor
param.label: Confounding factor
param.help: Secondary sample metadata variable to account for (e.g., Gender, Batch, Sampling date, etc.).

param.name: model_type
param.label: Model type
param.help: Choose an additive model (+) if the effects of the two variables are independent, or an interaction model (*) if their effects are expected to depend on each other.

param.label: Function abundances file (.tsv)
param.help: Input file containing predicted function abundances (e.g., 'picrust2_functions: EC_unstrat_abundance.tsv' generated by the FROGS Func 'picrust2_function' tool).

param.label: Sample metadata file (.tsv)
param.help: Tabular file containing metadata describing each sample (e.g., Treatment, Site, Host type, etc.).

param.label: Experimental variable
param.help: Sample metadata variable expected to influence functional abundances (e.g., Treatment, Environment, Site, etc.).

param.name: correction
param.label: Correct for a confounding factor?
param.help: If yes, specify an additional sample metadata variable to account for (e.g., Batch, Gender, etc.).

param.name: conf_factor
param.label: Confounding factor
param.help: Secondary sample metadata variable to control for (e.g., Gender, Batch, Sampling date, etc.).

param.name: model_type
param.label: Model type
param.help: Choose an additive model (+) if the effects of both variables are independent, or an interaction model (*) if their effects depend on each other.
